clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the Death Certificate.

clientSteps.action: Attend an interview about the cause of death and sign the certificate.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Consult with the doctor and sign the Death Certificate.

clientSteps.action: Receive the signed Death Certificate and proceed to the Civil Registry Office for registration.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Record and release the signed Death Certificate.

notes: After receiving the signed certificate, proceed to the City Civil Registry Office to complete the registration.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Consult with the doctor.

notes: After receiving the prepared certificate, proceed to the City Civil Registry Office for Order of Payment and registration.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive, review, and record the Death Certificate, then prepare the Transfer Certificate.

clientSteps.action: Receive the Certificate of Transfer of Cadaver.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Certificate of Transfer of Cadaver.

clientSteps.action: Proceed to the City Civil Registry Office for Order of Payment.

notes: After receiving the certificate, proceed to the City Civil Registry Office for the Order of Payment and burial transfer authorization.

service: Permit ng Sanitasyon (Sanitary Permit)
description: Issues an annual Sanitary Permit certifying that a business establishment in Calamba City complies with public health and sanitation requirements. Required by law for all business establishments before they can operate.
officeDivision: City Health Services Office — Sanitation and Information Section
whoMayAvail: Business establishment owners in Calamba City

detailedRequirements.requirement: Health Certificates of all employees (food handlers, etc.)
Water Refilling Stations: 40-hour seminar from DOH, Health Certificate, Operational Permit, Water Analysis (Physico-Chemical)
Lying-in / Hospital / Diagnostic Clinic: License to Operate (LTO) from DOH, Healthcare Waste Management documents
Funeral Parlor: Embalmer's License, Memorandum of Agreement (MOA)
Drug Store / Pharmacy: License to Operate from FDA
Company (Food/Non-Food): Annual APE, Vermin Control Program, Health Certificate, Water Analysis (Physico-Chemical)
Schools: Sanitary Permit, Annual Medical Certificate
Water Provider: Certificate of Potability, Water Analysis (Physico-Chemical)
Other establishments: Medical Health Certificate (requirements vary by establishment type)

clientSteps.action: Submit the Application Form and required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive, verify, and record documents; interview the applicant; issue Order of Payment and process the permit.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the City Treasury Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept payment and issue Official Receipt.
clientSteps.fee: Based on business gross income / establishment type

clientSteps.action: Present the Official Receipt and claim the Sanitary Permit.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Conduct actual inspection of the establishment (for new applicants), then release the Sanitary Permit.

fees.description: Based on business gross income or establishment type

notes: New establishments require an actual on-site inspection before the permit is released.

service: Serbisyong Pang-Laboratoryo (Laboratory Services)
description: Provides free basic laboratory testing services (blood, urine, stool, etc.) at the City Health Office, with results reviewed by a doctor who prescribes the appropriate treatment.

City Health Office Main Health Center

clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review the request, collect the specimen, interview the patient, conduct the actual analysis, and release the results.

clientSteps.action: Have laboratory results reviewed by a doctor.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review laboratory results and prescribe medication.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Dispense the medication.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Verify the referral, record the patient, take vital signs, conduct the medical examination, and prescribe medication.

description: Provides free family planning counseling and services at the City Health Office, including information on various contraception methods and the actual procedures (excluding permanent methods such as ligation and vasectomy).

clientSteps.agencyAction: Record the client.

description: Provides free ante-natal (pre-delivery) and post-natal (after delivery) health services to mothers through Barangay Health Stations and the City Health Office, including check-ups, Tetanus Toxoid vaccination, and vitamins.

clientSteps.agencyAction: Verify and record the patient, take vital signs, and interview the patient.

service: Newborn Screening
description: Screens newborns aged 48–72 hours old for five congenital disorders through a heel-prick blood test. Samples are sent to the New Born Screening Center in Southern Luzon, Tanauan for analysis.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Newborn infant aged 48–72 hours old (must be present)
detailedRequirements.where_to_secure: City Health Office Main Health Center

clientSteps.action: Complete and submit required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Verify and record patient information, interview parent/guardian, and provide health education about the five disorders being screened.

clientSteps.action: The newborn's left heel is pricked to collect a blood sample.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Prepare and massage the newborn's heel, collect the blood sample on a filter card, and allow to dry.

clientSteps.action: Wait for results (approximately 3 weeks).
clientSteps.agencyAction: Send sample to New Born Screening Center (Southern Luzon, Tanauan) for processing.

clientSteps.action: Claim the screening result.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the result from the Health Center. If positive: assist the patient in further testing and management.

processingTime: 1 day and 45 minutes (excluding the 3-week lab processing at the Screening Center)
notes: Results are available approximately three (3) weeks after submission, as samples are sent to the Newborn Screening Center in Tanauan, Southern Luzon.

sources.name: City Health Services Office Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Serbisyong Konsultasyon Laban sa Tuberculosis (TB Consultation)
description: Provides free tuberculosis (TB) consultation, screening, diagnosis, and treatment services for adults at the City Health Office, including sputum testing, chest X-ray, HIV testing, and DOT (Directly Observed Treatment) medication.

clientSteps.action: Register and provide personal information.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Interview, record patient information, and issue a chest X-ray request.

clientSteps.action: Submit the chest X-ray result and required documents.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review X-ray and process documents. If X-ray is positive: request GeneXpert sputum test. If negative: refer to a specialist. Provide TB and HIV health education, and conduct HIV screening.

clientSteps.action: Receive medication.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Dispense medication or prescription as needed.

clientSteps.action: Receive medication.

service: Gamutan para sa mga Nakagat ng Hayop (Animal Bite Treatment)
description: Provides free anti-rabies treatment and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for residents bitten by animals. Treatment follows the WHO animal bite category guidelines, including ERIG injection for Category III bites.

detailedRequirements.requirement: Barangay Investigation Report (about the biting animal)

clientSteps.action: Register your name and submit the Barangay Investigation Report.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Interview the patient, record information, provide health education and vaccination schedule, administer anti-rabies vaccine, and administer ERIG injection for Category III bites.
clientSteps.processing_time: 1 hour and 25 minutes (10 min + 15 min + 15 min + 1 hour for ERIG)

notes: Equine Rabies Immunoglobulin (ERIG) injection is required for Category III animal bites and adds approximately 1 hour to the treatment.

notes: If test results are non-compliant, the client will be referred to the Social Hygienic Clinic for thorough assessment and management.
